title: Starting the Journal
paragraphs: I added this Journal to share notes from my trips and updates on LENS. I wanted a place to write about the projects I visit while I’m still working through the recordings, and to share a little of how the archive is coming together.

title: A trip to Los Angeles
paragraphs: I presented at the 2026 ASLA Conference on Landscape Architecture in Los Angeles. While there, I recorded Tongva Park in Santa Monica and The Broad and its adjoining plaza in downtown Los Angeles. I’m preparing these recordings for LENS.
imageAlt: Curving paths, planted terraces and seating at Tongva Park in Santa Monica.

title: Smale Riverfront Park is online
paragraphs: I added three recordings from Smale Riverfront Park to LENS. I filmed at the swing pergola, the sculpture area and the water features during my visit to Cincinnati.
imageAlt: Three views along the Ohio River

title: The first recordings on YouTube
paragraphs: I uploaded the first LENS recordings to YouTube. I started with two projects in Guangzhou: Yongqing Fang and Huacheng Plaza on the Zhujiang Xincheng central axis.

title: LENS is online
paragraphs: I launched LENS and connected the site to lens-vr.com. I’m building a VR archive of contemporary urban public spaces for landscape architecture education and research.

title: Summer fieldwork in China
paragraphs: I recorded several public-space projects in China this summer. I’ll go through the footage and add the projects to LENS as I finish editing.

title: A trip to Cincinnati
paragraphs: I visited Cincinnati for the CELA conference and recorded Smale Riverfront Park, Zaha Hadid’s Contemporary Arts Center and Fountain Square. I also visited the University of Cincinnati to see the campus landscapes by Hargreaves Associates.
imageAlt: Lawns, terraced seating and paths on the University of Cincinnati campus.

title: A November visit to Seattle
paragraphs: I went to Seattle in November to record several landscape projects, including the newly opened Waterfront Park on Elliott Bay. I also met someone from GGN during the trip.
